# Synthetic Note B

Identity: `pr04-note-b`; controlling version: `v2 (2026-10-15)`.
This is an authored, public engineering fixture, not an actual literature claim.

## Theorem 2.1

For every real a >= 0 and real epsilon > 0, a + epsilon > 0.
Proof: adding epsilon to a >= 0 gives a + epsilon >= epsilon > 0.
Its hypotheses include the strict inequality epsilon > 0.

## Version warning

No statement in this note proves that a + epsilon > 0 when epsilon = 0.
